security.title: For the reviewer who reads the schema before the sales deck.

isolation.label: Isolation model
isolation.detail: Row Level Security on every tenant table, scoped via is_org_member(organization_id). No cross-tenant query path exists at the database layer.

privilegedOps.label: Privileged operations
privilegedOps.detail: Org creation and invitation acceptance run as SECURITY DEFINER functions with an explicit search_path, so elevated writes happen only through audited, narrow entry points.

serviceRole.label: Service-role boundary
serviceRole.detail: The Supabase service-role key is used only in server-only contexts — Stripe/PayTR webhook handlers and the anonymous customer booking API — never shipped to the client.

paymentVerification.label: Payment verification
paymentVerification.detail: Stripe and PayTR webhooks verify request signatures before writing subscription or payment state; unverified requests are rejected before touching the database.

deployment.label: Deployment surface
deployment.detail: Runs as a non-root user in a multi-stage Docker build on Next.js standalone output, deployed to AWS ECS Fargate behind a load balancer with a dedicated health-check endpoint.

operations.headline: Nobody double-books a slot again.
operations.body: Availability, services, and appointments live behind a database trigger that rejects overlapping bookings at write time — not a client-side check that a race condition can slip past.

security.headline: Tenant isolation enforced in the database, not the app layer.
security.body: Every table carries an organization_id and a Row Level Security policy scoped through is_org_member(). A compromised or buggy query can't cross a tenant boundary — Postgres refuses the row before your code ever sees it.

finance.headline: Subscription state stays in sync with Stripe, automatically.
finance.body: Checkout, plan changes, and cancellations flow through signature-verified Stripe webhooks that write directly to each organization's subscription record — no manual reconciliation.

features.multiTenant: Multi-tenant architecture with Postgres row-level security enforced at the database layer, not in application code.
features.payments: Stripe and PayTR billing behind a single provider-agnostic adapter — swap providers without touching checkout logic.
features.rag: An AI knowledge-base chatbot grounded in your own documentation via pgvector similarity search.

features.observability: Sentry error tracking wired in across client, server, and edge runtimes from day one.
